name: ezpowers
description: Project-local specification, planning, deterministic verification, evidence, and resume support for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Project-local specs, plans, verification, evidence, and resume.
interface.longDescription: EZPowers keeps project-specific intent, plans, verification commands, completion evidence, and resume state consistent across Claude Code and Codex. Its retained skills are ezpowers:setup, ezpowers:deep-interview, ezpowers:design-architecture, ezpowers:spec, ezpowers:prepare-execute, ezpowers:execute, ezpowers:frontend-design, ezpowers:improve-codebase-architecture, and ezpowers:hud. Native host features remain responsible for coding, subagents, worktrees, sandboxing, and general retry behavior.
defaultPrompt: $ezpowers:setup Install the project-local EZPowers workflow and verification kit.
$ezpowers:execute Run the prepared plan and deterministic project checks.
$ezpowers:hud Configure the native Codex model and usage footer.
